sentences.japanese: 金門橋は鉄でできている。
sentences.english: The Golden Gate Bridge is made of iron.
Gold is more precious than iron.

sentences.japanese: その鉄の棒はさびてぼろぼろになった。
sentences.english: Rust ate away the iron bar.

sentences.japanese: 錆が鉄を虫食むのと同様に心配は心を虫食む。
sentences.english: As rust eats iron, so care eats the heart.
